descriptionFull: The common kestrel ( Falco tinnunculus ) is a bird of prey species belonging to the kestrel group of the falcon family Falconidae. It is also known as the European kestrel , Eurasian kestrel , or Old World kestrel . In Britain, where no other kestrel species occurs, it is generally just called "the kestrel ".
